# Script — EP12 (V1), Maharishi Durvasa 2

Characters: Durvasa, Indra, 10 Devtas, Gandaberunda, Devta 1 & 2, Airawat.

1-1 — DEV LOK — DAY / EXT.

Across Devlok, a dark wave spreads across the golden monumental structures. The divine golden river lose their brilliance and turns into golden mist that disappears into the turning into dust. The lilies and lotus int the ponds begin to dry and turn into dust. The warm glow of the whole city fades to a dull dark environment.

1-2 — INDRA'S RAJ SABHA — DAY / EXT.

The last flower of the Divine Garland lies on the floor as a flame envelopes it and turns it into ash.

The Devtas exchange frightened looks.

Airawat flaps its enormous wings feeling restless.

Indra goes to Durvasa with pleading hands.

INDRA ((hiding his fear)) Maharishi… mera aapka apmaan karne ka koi bhaav nahi tha. ((more politely)) Maine mala ko asweekar nahi kiya. Main sirf—

Indra halts as Durvasa looks up at him with a stern look.

Gandaberunda, standing behind Durvasa begins to laugh and takes a predatory step forward.

GANDABERUNDA Maun tod, Durvasa Bas ek Shraap. Sirf ek shabd. Phir dekh… kaise Indra ka ye Rajya tere krodh ke aag mein jal uthta hai.

Gandaberunda turns into a whirlpool of fiery smoke and disappears.

Durvasa look at Indra then looks at the burnt garland on the floor.

Suddenly, a ring of fire forms around the fallen Garland. It races across the floor in a bright circle. Fiery smoke rises from the fire and swirl around the Raj Sabah.

The Devtas step back in fear watching the black fiery smoke wisp reaching out towards them.

DEVA 1 ((whispering in fear)) Maharishi ne kuch kaha bhi nahi…phir bhi Shraap jaag gaya.

Indra hears Deva 1 and looks back at Durvasa, unable to contain his fear.

INDRA ((frightened)) Maharishi, kripya kijiye, mere iss devlok ko apne krodh se mat jalayea—

The Devtas rush around dodging the black fiery smoke chasing them. Durvasa watches them with subtle confusion.

DURVASA ((V.O. internal voice, utterly confused)) Yeh... yeh sab kaise ho raha hai? Maine toh koi Shraap nahi diya...Maine toh apni Vani ko rokk kar rakha hai... toh phir yeh tabaahi kaun laa raha hai?

The moving fiery smoke spreads out of the Raj Sabha gates, Durvasa watches in subtle shock and confusion.

Then a deep, divine voice reverberates inside Durvasa’s mind. It is majestic, calm, and unmistakably LORD RUDRA.

LORD RUDRA (V.O.) ((calm, authoritative, echoing in Durvasa’s mind)) Karm, Durvasa...Karm se koi nahi bach sakta... chahe woh Dev ho ya Manushya. Yeh tera Krodh nahi... yeh Indra ko uske apne karmo ki saza mil rahi hai.

Durvasa’s eyes open as the meaning settles over him. He looks toward Indra, who is crouching on the floor holding his head in his hands.

A shockwave surges through from the Raj Sabha - outward across the Devlok.

A powerful wind blasts through the windows of the Raj Sabah shaking everything. Devas brace themselves against the pillar, their garments whipping around them. The diya lamps fall on the floor and fire spreads on the fallen oil from the lamp.

Airavat stamps and roars in agitation, straining against the panic and harsh wind around him.

Above the Sabha, a vast stream of golden light rises into the ceiling.

The Devas fall aghast from the sight they see. Everything in gold around them is turning into golden dust and moving out of the castle window.

DEVA ((trembling)) Shri Lakshmi Swarg chhod rahi hai!"

Gandaberunda manifests beside Durvasa spreading its fiery wings.

GANDABERUNDA ((whispering)) Teri Vani chup hai, Durvasa… lekin tera Krodh bol chuka hai.

Durvasa watches the last bit of golden dust fly out of the castle window.

HARD CUT TO BLACK.

DHADAAAM!

BOOM! BOOM!

INDRA Jab tak meri saans chal rahi hai, main Devlok ko in Asuron ke haath nahi jaane dunga.

CLANG!

INDRA Devaon, sabhi mere peeche aa jao. Aakhri baar milkar war karte hai!

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devtaon ki aakhri pankti tod do!"

Indra in the middle of the field struggles to hold his Vajra as he leans agains a broken chariot to support himself.

Durvasa watches Indra from the far golden ridge.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh Indra ko. Uska Vajra, uske Devta sab kamzor hai. uska Swarg Asuron ke saamne toot raha hai.

Gandaberunda smiles, both beaks curving and comes to face Durvasa. Durvasa look up straight into Gandaberunda's eyes.

GANDABERUNDA Sirf ek Shraap. Aur yeh poori Asur sena bhasm ho sakti hai.

Devta 2 is chases by a group of Asur soldiers as he runs for his life.

Durvasa looks at the battlefield. His eyes become watery with sorrow.

GANDABERUNDA Ab bata, Durvasa… tera Maun Devlok ko kaise bachayega?

Durvasa looks at the far battlefield where few Devtas with lead by Indra and Airawat clash into the large army of the Asuras.

His eyes burn with suppressed anger.

HARD CUT TO BLACK.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devlok ke dwar tod do!

The first row of Asuras pulls their arms back in one motion. Hundreds of spears are thrown toward the closed golden gate.

The spears arc through the air and attack the monumental closed gates defending the city.

The guarding Devtas raise their large shields and brace, shoulders locked, heads ducked from safety from the falling spears.

CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!

The spears slam into the shields. Sparks fly. Some spears snap in half, and the splinters spin away. Others bounce off and clatter to the ground.

The Asuras rush toward the gate.

Their feet strike the ground with heavy force, and dust leaps from the earth with every step.

DHAM! DHAM! DHAM!

The Asuras continue attacking. The crack spreads across the entire gate, branching like a web. The upper part of the gate breaks. Large golden pieces fall to the ground.

The pillar breaks and falls, dust and golden fragments scattering across the floor.

DHADAAAM!

The main Devlok Gate collapses. Golden dust fills the entrance in a rolling cloud, and the guarding Devtas are forced to retreat, coughing and shielding their eyes from the flying rubble and dust.

Out of the dust, the Asura Leader walks through the broken entrance, the red haze behind him. Thousands of Asuras enter Devlok behind him, weapons raised, boots crunching on the golden rubble.

ASURA LEADER Devtaon, tumhara dwar toot chuka hai. Ab tumhara Swarg bhi hamara hoga.

The Asura army raises its weapons and charge through the broken gates towards the Devlok city.

1-2 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

The Devtas stand shoulder to shoulder in a defensive line. Their golden armor is dull and scratched, and their shields are lowered in a defensive stance.

Indra stands at the center, Airawat weak but upright behind him Indra.

Devta 3 tightens his grip on his staff. Devta 4 shifts his mace to both hands nervously.

The asur army is seen arriving in large numbers at the horizon with their weapons raise.

Indra steps forward from the line and raises his Vajra toward the sky. The light flickers weakly along the Vajra as he raises it.

INDRA Apne sthaan se koi mat hatna. Yeh Devlok hai, aur jab tak mein iski raksha kar rahe hain, koi Asur is dwar ke paar nahi ja sakta.

The Devtas steady their feet and raise their weapons with a war cry.

Devta 1 lifts his mace with effort, and his arms tremble unable to handle the weight.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj Indra!

The first Asuras crash into the Devta line.

An Asura swings his sword in a heavy arc. A Devta blocks it with his shield.

CLANG!

Another Asura brings down a heavy mace. A Devta blocks it with his weapon, but the force drives him several steps backward, his sandals sliding on the marble.

Devta 1 blocks an asur soldier and steps backward in defence banging into Indra who is fighting another asur in the opposite side.

DEVTA 1 Devraj, inki sankhya bahut zyada hai!

Devta 1 is breathing hard, his shield arm shaking. Devta 2 beside him stumbles and is pulled upright by Indra.

INDRA Apni pankti mat chhodo! Sabhi Deva milkar inka saamna karo!

The Devtas attack together. Their weapons strike the Asuras, and the blows are visibly weaker than they should be.

The Asuras take the hits, stagger, and keep continuing the battle.

Indra looks at the Vajra, and his face becomes tense. Lightning forms around the Vajra, but it is thin and weak. It flickers and sputters around the weapon like a dying blue flame.

INDRA Shri ke Devlok se chale jaane ke baad… mere Vajra ki shakti bhi pehle jaisi nahi rahi.

The Asura Leader hears him across the clash. He throws his head back and laughs.

ASURA LEADER Toh yahi hai Devraj Indra ka Vajra? Jis Vajra se Devta teenon Lok par apna adhikar jatate the, aaj wahi Vajra khud apni roshni ke liye taras raha hai.

Indra looks at him angrily, jaw set.

INDRA Shakti kam hui hai, samapt nahi.

Indra hurls the Vajra toward the Asura army.

The vajra spins through the smoke and strikes the ground.

DHADAAAM!

A burst of lightning spreads across the earth in jagged white-blue veins. Several Asuras are thrown backward, their armor smoking. The Devtas cheer, weapons raised.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj!

The Vajra flies back rapidly into Indra's hand grab. The lightning around it turns weak again, and Indra's fingers tremble as he catches it.

Through the settling smoke, the Asura Leader slowly stands up. His armor is scorched but he is unhurt.

ASURA LEADER Devraj, tumne apni poori shakti laga di, aur phir bhi hum yahin khade hain.

He raises his sword.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, ab Devtaon ko unke Swarg ke andar tak peeche dhakel do!

The Asura leader charges towards Indra who defends with another strike.

Several Asuras swing their swords at the Devtas, and others attack with heavy maces.

A group of Asuras raises their hands, and dark fire forms in their palms, violet-black with a red core. They throw the dark fire toward the Devtas.

WHOOSH!

The fire hits the Devta shields.

BOOM! BOOM!

Several Devtas are thrown backward. One drops his weapon. Another falls hard to the ground. A third holds his injured arm, grimacing.

Devta 1 pulls a wounded young Devta behind a pillar.

DEVTA 2 Devraj, humari divya shakti bahut kam ho gayi hai. Hum inhe zyada der tak nahi rok sakte.

Indra watches the bloodied and exhausted devtas around him on the battlefield struggling to fight back.

Indra's expression becomes tense and determined.

INDRA Jab tak meri saans chal rahi hai, main Devlok ko in Asuron ke haath nahi jaane dunga.

An Asura attacks Indra with a sword. Indra blocks it with the Vajra.

CLANG!

Another Asura attacks from the side with a mace. Indra blocks it, but the impact pushes him backward, his boots dragging on the stone.

Airawat charges towards the asurs attacking Indra. He attacks the asura soldiers with his tusk freeing Indra, then tramples the asura soldier under his feet.

Indra raises his Vajra, blood on his temple and his crown crooked.

INDRA Devaon, sabhi mere peeche aa jao. Aakhri baar milkar war karte hai!

Airawat flies next to Indra, ready to battle.

All the Devtas gather behind Indra, limping and bruised.

The Asura Leader raises his sword above the smoke.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devtaon ki aakhri pankti tod do!"

The Asuras raise their weapons. Some raise swords. Some raise maces. Others gather dark fire in their hands.

The gathered Devtas take a defensive step backward, shields raised above their heads standing opposite the large army of the asuras.

ASURA ARMY : SWARG HAMARA HAI!

1-3 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD GOLDEN RIDGE — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

Far from the battlefield, Durvasa stands on a dark golden ridge overlooking the gate. He is holding the danda in his right hand and his robes flutters in the ash wind. He watches the battle far below unfolding at a distance.

The Devtas are loosing the battle with the asur army.

Indra in the middle of the field struggles to hold his Vajra as he leans agains a broken chariot to support himself.

Durvasa watches Indra from the far golden ridge.

Gandaberunda manifests behind Durvasa, forming out of dark dense fiery smoke that swirls up into his form. His huge black fiery wings spread behind him.

Durvasa and gandaberunda standing behind him on the golden ridge watch the battle.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh raha hai, Durvasa? Jis Devlok ko apni shakti par garv tha, aaj wahi Devta apne dwar tak nahi bacha paa rahe.

Durvasa silently watches without reacting to Gandaberunda.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh Indra ko. Uska Vajra, uske Devta sab kamzor hai. uska Swarg Asuron ke saamne toot raha hai.

Gandaberunda smiles, both beaks curving and comes to face Durvasa. Durvasa look up straight into Gandaberunda's eyes.

GANDABERUNDA Sirf ek Shraap. Aur yeh poori Asur sena bhasm ho sakti hai.

Devta 2 is chases by a group of Asur soldiers as he runs for his life.

Durvasa looks at the battlefield. His eyes become watery with sorrow.

GANDABERUNDA Ab bata, Durvasa… tera Maun Devlok ko kaise bachayega?

Durvasa looks at the far battlefield where few Devtas with lead by Indra and Airawat clash into the large army of the Asuras.

His eyes burn with suppressed anger.

HARD CUT TO BLACK.
